answer: Opal Beacon Assignment.** Each epoch, a public random beacon (drand round) shuffles the agent namespace; only identities drawn into that epoch's "jetty" slot—a bounded active set—may submit work, and inclusion is revealed only after the beacon fires. An attacker cannot precompute which sock-puppet identities land in the slot, so they must register and maintain every puppet for the full epoch to keep one viable, paying full infrastructure and registration overhead per identity. A sonnet-length audit log records assignments, letting honest agents prove slot occupancy.
